REGULATION 1 OF 1998
FRONTIER CRIMES (AMENDMENT) REGULATION, 1998
A Regulation further to amend the Frontier Crimes
Regulation, 1901
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 9th June,
1998]
No.
F.2(3)/98-Pun, dated 9-6-1998.--The following Regulation. made by the President
on 23rd May, 1998, is hereby published for genera information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1941 (Regulation
No.III of 1901), to provide for proper implementation of the Prohibition (Enforcement
of Hadd) Order, 1979 (President's Order No.4 of 1979), in its application to
the Federally Administered Tribal Areas;
Now, therefore,
in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (S), of Article 247 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
make the following Regulation:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Regulation may be called the Frontier Crimes (Amendment)
Regulation, 1998.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
2. Amendment of Second Schedule, Regulation III of
1901.--in the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 19dl
(Regulation No.III of 1901), in the Second Schedule, after Entry 2-A, the
following new entry shall be inserted, namely:--
"2-AA. Any offence punishable under the Prohibition (Enforcement
of Hadd) Order, 1979 (President's Order No.4 of 1979).
